card.name: Volume units in infusion rate tables
card.fires_on: The L or mL of a volume unit, or the space or digit just before a dose number, in dosing tables and infusion rate charts. It appears where a rate such as mL/hr or a quantity in mg/mL is about to be given.

modes.label: mL in rate headings
modes.description: The L or mL in rate column headings such as mL/hr or mL/kg/min.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A space or digit just before a dose amount or concentration figure.
